# Get-ZbxWatch

## SYNOPSIS

Gets the running watches of the session.

## SYNTAX

```
Get-ZbxWatch [[-Name] <string>] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

The Get-ZbxWatch cmdlet writes the watches Watch-ZbxItem started in this runspace, or the one named in -Name: each with its name, when it started, how many reads succeeded and failed, and how many values its readers dropped. It reads only the runspace's own watches and sends nothing to the server.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: List the running watches

```powershell
Get-ZbxWatch | Select-Object Name, Started, SucceededPolls, FailedPolls
```

SucceededPolls and FailedPolls count the watch's reads of the server.

### Example 2: Check whether a reader lost values

```powershell
(Get-ZbxWatch -Name 'requests').Dropped
```

Dropped counts the values a slow Receive-ZbxWatch reader lost to its full buffer.

## PARAMETERS

### -Name

The watch's name; every running watch when omitted.

## INPUTS

None.

## OUTPUTS

- `ZabbixWatch`: Represents a running IZabbixWatcher, kept in the runspace's Sessions by name: started by Watch-ZbxItem, found by Get-ZbxWatch, read by Receive-ZbxWatch, stopped by Stop-ZbxWatch — or when the runspace closes.
